items.title: Forum Members Review the 'Vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 Collection From Demna
items.summary: theFashionSpot rounds up its own fashion-forum members' reactions to Demna's Sept 25 Spring 2027 Gucci show; commentary is overwhelmingly negative, calling it "a tragedy," "pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision," and predicting it could be Demna's final season. Genuine organic community critique, not brand-staged.

items.title: theFashionSpot forum thread on Gucci Spring/Summer 2027 continues with mixed-to-negative member replies
items.summary: Live forum thread (source for the roundup article above) shows individual member posts split between calling the collection derivative of DSquared2/Balenciaga-era Demna and a smaller minority defending it as his most personal Gucci statement yet; view/reply counts not exposed on page snapshot.

items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear Runway, Fashion Show & Collection Review
items.summary: WWD's trade-press critical review of Demna's second Gucci runway show (Sept 25, Milan); independent critic judgment on collection direction, positioned alongside more polarized fan-forum reaction. Full text sits behind a paywall/tollbit gate; listed per trade-press verdict convention.

items.source: Yahoo Finance / US News (Reuters wire, Berenberg/Barclays analyst quotes)
items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Reuters wire report (this NA syndication) says Gucci has begun selling new sneaker models labeled 'Made in China,' breaking with Italian-manufacturing tradition; Berenberg flags tension between provenance and luxury repositioning, a Milan consultant calls it 'not a good look,' and Barclays' Carole Madjo says investors are questioning continued buying as prices fall. Independent analyst-sourced criticism, not brand-originated.

items.title: "Gucci Morty" meme trend recirculates on TikTok with fresh September wave
items.summary: A years-old edited image of Rick and Morty's Morty dressed in Gucci regained a fresh wave of TikTok attention in September 2026, used by creators as reaction-format shorthand for a sudden confidence boost; purely cultural meme usage of the brand name with no evaluative content about Gucci itself, so treated as neutral incidental SNS volume rather than sentiment signal. Individual video-level metrics not accessible via aggregated discover page.

items.summary: Independent NA style-commentary creator short titled calling the Demna Gucci collection a flop; framed as personal critical opinion rather than brand-staged content, so scored as organic negative SNS sentiment. View/like counts not visible without opening the platform player.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci sub-forum active discussion continues on Demna-era bags and quality
items.summary: Ongoing PurseForum Gucci community activity (distinct from the two specific threads pooled on 2026-09-26) includes members comparing new Borsetto and Flora-print construction quality to earlier Michele-era pieces, with recurring value-for-money questions about materials at current price points; forum index page does not expose vote/view counts.

items.title: Demna's Runway Debut at Gucci Was 'More Good Than Bad,' Says Bernstein
items.summary: WWD reports Bernstein's sell-side analyst note scoring Demna's fall 2026 Gucci collection 7.6 out of 10, calling it 'clearly not a home run, but still an improvement'; independent financial-analyst judgment, mixed-to-mildly-positive but explicitly hedged, not a full endorsement.
